topology: One machine; real React guest pages -> HTTP Gateway -> TCP Core -> SQLite
measurement: One browser clock per actor. Full operation response includes IndexedDB/session/place response; render is first DOM detection after accepted receipt. HTTP duration includes cloned response body. Byte counts are decoded HTTP bodies, not TCP/TLS bytes.
loadModel: Each browser starts at most one sequential order/payment flow per 1-second slot; overruns are recorded, not overlapped. Warmup excluded from timed samples but included in database oracle.
